g.text: The linked list grows at the head: each new book goes in front
ajouter_elem_list(B, num, titre, auteur) with books 1, 2, 3 of GdeBiblio.txt. Yellow = node just created.
2. Insert num 1: it becomes the head
3. Insert num 2: new node points to old head, head moves to it
4. Insert num 3: same two steps, the list is now 3 -> 2 -> 1
